scope: Public web information and generic product concepts only. No private operating metrics, code, buyer records, sales records or internal strategy. Research advice, not approval or revenue prediction.

public_sources.facts: Public offers are GBP150 for a one-off four-week one-region Weekly Digest pilot and GBP745 one-off Territory Opportunity Brief. Free directory. Digest enquiry is sales-assisted. Public brief includes territory dataset, a shortlist and an evidence-based report.

CQC supplies API and directory data under Open Government Licence. API daily, CSV normally weekly; source systems can cause delays. Includes England health and care locations; does not include email addresses. An archived location does not necessarily mean business closure.
Advertised CareSearch GBP1655-3150/year, Care Homes Database Subscription GBP3999/year, Care Quality Benchmarks GBP599-5745/year. Advertised prices are not proof of another company's demand.
Care Quality Benchmarks Essential GBP599+VAT per year for 12 personalised monthly quality reports. CareSearch Premium with benchmarks GBP3399+VAT/year.
Care-sector search and account targeting dashboard advertised GBP199/year. Customer numbers and feature quality not verified.

Care consultancy offers registration support, mock inspections, CQC consultancy, governance, turnaround and interim management. Shows a relevant business workflow; no claim they have purchased CareGist.
CQC assessment pilots June-October 2026 with evaluation November 2026. Assessment-framework-dependent tools need maintenance.

generic_candidate_concepts.regional_monitoring: Personalised weekly care-market monitoring for consultancy firms, initially a defined paid pilot; ongoing service only if customers value recurring updates. Saved provider/client lists and verified changes can support a recurring review workflow.
generic_candidate_concepts.territory_research: Human-reviewed territory strategy report for care-sector sales teams; repeated planning exercises can justify new quarterly research, though a one-off report alone is not recurring revenue.
generic_candidate_concepts.licensed_feed: Maintained licensed data feed for software or CRM tools. Stable identity, provenance, change history, replay and integration support could create ongoing value beyond the free upstream API; requires paid integration validation.
generic_candidate_concepts.provider_benchmarking: Personalised monthly public quality-rating comparison reports for care groups; established competitor at GBP599/year limits price room without a meaningful extra benefit.
generic_candidate_concepts.static_directory: Sell generic lists or raw directory access; freely available upstream data and low-priced competitors limit differentiation and recurring use.
generic_candidate_concepts.inspection_readiness: Sell mock inspection and readiness support directly to care providers; needs qualified practitioners, internal provider evidence and ongoing regulatory-framework expertise.
generic_candidate_concepts.paid_listings: Sell sponsored provider directory listings; recurring demand depends on evidenced consumer traffic and enquiries, not record count.

rules: Do not invent customer demand, sales probability, revenue, operator capabilities or retention evidence. Rank only these generic jobs against the public evidence. No guarantee a product will sell. Future rankings are conditional hypotheses.
